title: A characterization of compact open spectral sets in $\mathbb{Q}_p^d$
summary: Let $Ω\subset \Qp^d$ be a compact open set. Such a set, without lose of generality, admits a representation \(Ω= \bigsqcup_{c \in C} (c + p^n\Zp^d)\), where $C \subset (\Z/p^n\Z)^d$ and $n \in\N$. We prove that $Ω$ tiles $\Qp^d$ by translation if and only if $C$ tiles $(\Z/p^n\Z)^d$ by translation. Moreover, $Ω$ is a spectral set in $\Qp^d$ if and only if $C$ is a spectral set in $(\Z/p^n\Z)^d$.
